title: Butterfly Lovers
synopsis: This is our elementary level adaptation of the classic Chinese legend “Butterfly Lovers”.

fullText.simplified:
小英想：回家后，我就不能见大山了。我喜欢大山，我想做他的妻子，我想和他天天在一起。我要告诉大山我喜欢他。但是，我一个女孩子，要怎么说出“我喜欢你”？
    那个时候，女孩子都是听爸爸妈妈的话，爸爸妈妈说要她们做谁的妻子，她们就要做谁的妻子。她们喜欢也好，不喜欢也好，爸爸妈妈说什么她们就要去做什么。所以，那个时候，女孩子不会和男孩子说“我喜欢你”这样的话。
    那小英要怎么做？要她去和大山说“我喜欢你”，她会很不好意思。但是不说的话，大山就不知道她是女孩子，也就不会喜欢她了。怎么办？小英想到了一个好办法。
    小英找到钱红，对她说：“钱阿姨，我就要回家了。我想请你帮我一个忙。”
    “好啊，你说吧！”钱红说。这三年，小英心里有什么事，都会去找钱红说。因为在这个学校里，只有钱红知道她是女孩子。女孩子的心事，小英只会找钱红说。钱红也很喜欢听小英说心事，她很喜欢小英，她觉得小英就像她的女儿一样。
    “我想请你帮我告诉大山，我喜欢他。”小英坐了很长时间后，说了出来。
    钱红笑了，说：“好！我会告诉他，你是女孩子，你喜欢他，你想做他的妻子。你看这样可以吗？”
    “谢谢钱阿姨！”小英高兴地跳了起来。
    钱红笑着说：“不客气！”
    第二天，小英要回家了。大山和小英走出学校。大山很不想这个“弟弟”回家，他很喜欢和这个“弟弟”在一起。一路上，大山和小英都没有说话。
fullText.traditional:
小英想：回家後，我就不能見大山了。我喜歡大山，我想做他的妻子，我想和他天天在一起。我要告訴大山我喜歡他。但是，我一個女孩子，要怎麼說出“我喜歡你”？
    那個時候，女孩子都是聽爸爸媽媽的話，爸爸媽媽說要她們做誰的妻子，她們就要做誰的妻子。她們喜歡也好，不喜歡也好，爸爸媽媽說什麼她們就要去做什麼。所以，那個時候，女孩子不會和男孩子說“我喜歡你”這樣的話。
    那小英要怎麼做？要她去和大山說“我喜歡你”，她會很不好意思。但是不說的話，大山就不知道她是女孩子，也就不會喜歡她了。怎麼辦？小英想到了一個好辦法。
    小英找到錢紅，對她說：“錢阿姨，我就要回家了。我想請你幫我一個忙。”
    “好啊，你說吧！”錢紅說。這三年，小英心裡有什麼事，都會去找錢紅說。因為在這個學校裡，只有錢紅知道她是女孩子。女孩子的心事，小英只會找錢紅說。錢紅也很喜歡聽小英說心事，她很喜歡小英，她覺得小英就像她的女兒一樣。
    “我想請你幫我告訴大山，我喜歡他。”小英坐了很長時間後，說了出來。
    錢紅笑了，說：“好！我會告訴他，你是女孩子，你喜歡他，你想做他的妻子。你看這樣可以嗎？”
    “謝謝錢阿姨！”小英高興地跳了起來。
    錢紅笑著說：“不客氣！”
    第二天，小英要回家了。大山和小英走出學校。大山很不想這個“弟弟”回家，他很喜歡和這個“弟弟”在一起。一路上，大山和小英都沒有說話。

sentences.simplified: 小英想：回家后，我就不能见大山了。
sentences.traditional: 小英想：回家後，我就不能見大山了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng xiǎng huí jiā hòu wǒ jiù bù néng jiàn dà shān le
sentences.english: Xiao Ying thought: After I return home, I won’t be able to see Dashan anymore.

sentences.simplified: 我喜欢大山，我想做他的妻子，我想和他天天在一起。
sentences.traditional: 我喜歡大山，我想做他的妻子，我想和他天天在一起。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huan dà shān wǒ xiǎng zuò tā de qī zi wǒ xiǎng hé tā tiān tiān zài yì qǐ
sentences.english: I like Dashan, I want to be his wife, I want to be together with him every day.

sentences.simplified: 我要告诉大山我喜欢他。
sentences.traditional: 我要告訴大山我喜歡他。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yào gào su dà shān wǒ xǐ huan tā
sentences.english: I have to tell Dashan I like him.

sentences.simplified: 但是，我一个女孩子，要怎么说出“我喜欢你”？
sentences.traditional: 但是，我一個女孩子，要怎麼說出“我喜歡你”？
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì wǒ yí ge nǚ hái zi yào zěn me shuō chū wǒ xǐ huan nǐ
sentences.english: But, I’m a girl, how do I say “I like you”?

sentences.simplified: 那个时候，女孩子都是听爸爸妈妈的话，
sentences.traditional: 那個時候，女孩子都是聽爸爸媽媽的話，
sentences.pinyin: nà ge shí hou nǚ hái zi dōu shì tīng bà ba mā ma de huà
sentences.english: At that time, all girls did what their Father and Mother said.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸妈妈说要她们做谁的妻子，她们就要做谁的妻子。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸媽媽說要她們做誰的妻子，她們就要做誰的妻子。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba mā ma shuō yào tā men zuò shéi de qī zi tā men jiù yào zuò shéi de qī zi
sentences.english: Father and Mother said whose wife they wanted them to be, and they would have to be that someone’s wife.

sentences.simplified: 她们喜欢也好，不喜欢也好，爸爸妈妈说什么她们就要去做什么。
sentences.traditional: 她們喜歡也好，不喜歡也好，爸爸媽媽說什麼她們就要去做什麼。
sentences.pinyin: tā men xǐ huan yě hǎo bù xǐ huan yě hǎo bà ba mā ma shuō shén me tā men jiù yào qù zuò shén me
sentences.english: Regardless if they liked it or not, they would have to do whatever Father and Mother said.

sentences.simplified: 所以，那个时候，女孩子不会和男孩子说“我喜欢你”这样的话。
sentences.traditional: 所以，那個時候，女孩子不會和男孩子說“我喜歡你”這樣的話。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ nà ge shí hou nǚ hái zi bú huì hé nán hái zi shuō wǒ xǐ huan nǐ zhè yàng de huà
sentences.english: Therefore, at that time, girls couldn’t say things like “I like you” to boys.

sentences.simplified: 那小英要怎么做？
sentences.traditional: 那小英要怎麼做？
sentences.pinyin: nà xiǎo yīng yào zěn me zuò
sentences.english: Then what should Xiao Ying do?

sentences.simplified: 要她去和大山说“我喜欢你”，她会很不好意思。
sentences.traditional: 要她去和大山說“我喜歡你”，她會很不好意思。
sentences.pinyin: yào tā qù hé dà shān shuō wǒ xǐ huan nǐ tā huì hěn bù hǎo yì si
sentences.english: If she went and said “I like you” to Dashan, she would feel very embarrassed.

sentences.simplified: 但是不说的话，大山就不知道她是女孩子，也就不会喜欢她了。
sentences.traditional: 但是不說的話，大山就不知道她是女孩子，也就不會喜歡她了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì bù shuō de huà dà shān jiù bù zhī dào tā shì nǚ hái zi yě jiù bú huì xǐ huan tā le
sentences.english: But if she didn’t say it, Dashan wouldn’t know that she was a girl, and also wouldn't like her.

sentences.simplified: 怎么办？小英想到了一个好办法。
sentences.traditional: 怎麼辦？小英想到了一個好辦法。
sentences.pinyin: zěn me bàn xiǎo yīng xiǎng dào le yí ge hǎo bàn fǎ
sentences.english: What to do? Xiao Ying thought up a good way to do it.

sentences.simplified: 小英找到钱红，对她说：
sentences.traditional: 小英找到錢紅，對她說：
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng zhǎo dào qián hóng duì tā shuō
sentences.english: Xiao Ying found Qian Hong, and said to her:

sentences.simplified: “钱阿姨，我就要回家了。我想请你帮我一个忙。”
sentences.traditional: “錢阿姨，我就要回家了。我想請你幫我一個忙。”
sentences.pinyin: qián ā yí wǒ jiù yào huí jiā le wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ yí ge máng
sentences.english: “Aunt Qian, I have to return home. I want to ask you to help me with something.”

sentences.simplified: “好啊，你说吧！”钱红说。
sentences.traditional: “好啊，你說吧！”錢紅說。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo a nǐ shuō ba qián hóng shuō
sentences.english: “Ok, say it!” Qian Hong said.

sentences.simplified: 这三年，小英心里有什么事，都会去找钱红说。
sentences.traditional: 這三年，小英心裡有什麼事，都會去找錢紅說。
sentences.pinyin: zhè sān nián xiǎo yīng xīn li yǒu shén me shì dōu huì qù zhǎo qián hóng shuō
sentences.english: These three years, if Xiao Ying had something on her mind, she would always go look for Qian Hong to talk.

sentences.simplified: 因为在这个学校里，只有钱红知道她是女孩子。
sentences.traditional: 因為在這個學校裡，只有錢紅知道她是女孩子。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zài zhè ge xué xiào lǐ zhǐ yǒu qián hóng zhī dào tā shì nǚ hái zi
sentences.english: Because in this school, it was only Qian Hong that knew that she was a girl.

sentences.simplified: 女孩子的心事，小英只会找钱红说。
sentences.traditional: 女孩子的心事，小英只會找錢紅說。
sentences.pinyin: nǚ hái zi de xīn shì xiǎo yīng zhǐ huì zhǎo qián hóng shuō
sentences.english: Xiao Ying could only look to Qian Hong to talk about girl worries.

sentences.simplified: 钱红也很喜欢听小英说心事，
sentences.traditional: 錢紅也很喜歡聽小英說心事，
sentences.pinyin: qián hóng yě hěn xǐ huan tīng xiǎo yīng shuō xīn shì
sentences.english: Qian Hong also really liked to listen to Xiao Ying talk about her worries.

sentences.simplified: 她很喜欢小英，她觉得小英就像她的女儿一样。
sentences.traditional: 她很喜歡小英，她覺得小英就像她的女兒一樣。
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn xǐ huan xiǎo yīng tā jué de xiǎo yīng jiù xiàng tā de nǚ ér yí yàng
sentences.english: She really liked Xiao Ying and thought that Xiao Ying was just like her own daughter.

sentences.simplified: “我想请你帮我告诉大山，我喜欢他。”小英坐了很长时间后，说了出来。
sentences.traditional: “我想請你幫我告訴大山，我喜歡他。”小英坐了很長時間後，說了出來。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ gào su dà shān wǒ xǐ huan tā xiǎo yīng zuò le hěn cháng shí jiān hòu shuō le chū lái
sentences.english: “I want to ask you to help me tell Dashan that I like him.” Xiao Ying said a long time after she sat down.

sentences.simplified: 钱红笑了，说：
sentences.traditional: 錢紅笑了，說：
sentences.pinyin: qián hóng xiào le shuō
sentences.english: Qian Hong smiled and said:

sentences.simplified: “好！我会告诉他，你是女孩子，你喜欢他，你想做他的妻子。你看这样可以吗？”
sentences.traditional: “好！我會告訴他，你是女孩子，你喜歡他，你想做他的妻子。你看這樣可以嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: hǎo wǒ huì gào su tā nǐ shì nǚ hái zi nǐ xǐ huan tā nǐ xiǎng zuò tā de qī zi nǐ kàn zhè yàng kě yǐ ma
sentences.english: “Ok! I will tell him you’re a girl, you like him, and you want to be his wife. Do you think it would work this way?”

sentences.simplified: “谢谢钱阿姨！”小英高兴地跳了起来。
sentences.traditional: “謝謝錢阿姨！”小英高興地跳了起來。
sentences.pinyin: xiè xie qián ā yí xiǎo yīng gāo xìng de tiào le qǐ lái
sentences.english: “Thank you Aunt Qian!” Xiao Ying happily jumped up.

sentences.simplified: 钱红笑着说：“不客气！”
sentences.traditional: 錢紅笑著說：“不客氣！”
sentences.pinyin: qián hóng xiào zhe shuō bú kè qi
sentences.english: Qian Hong said smilingly: “Don’t mention it!”

sentences.simplified: 第二天，小英要回家了。大山和小英走出学校。
sentences.traditional: 第二天，小英要回家了。大山和小英走出學校。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr tiān xiǎo yīng yào huí jiā le dà shān hé xiǎo yīng zǒu chū xué xiào
sentences.english: The next day, Xiao Ying had to return home. Dashan and Xiao Ying walked out of the school.

sentences.simplified: 大山很不想这个“弟弟”回家，他很喜欢和这个“弟弟”在一起。
sentences.traditional: 大山很不想這個“弟弟”回家，他很喜歡和這個“弟弟”在一起。
sentences.pinyin: dà shān hěn bù xiǎng zhè ge dì di huí jiā tā hěn xǐ huan hé zhè ge dì di zài yì qǐ
sentences.english: Dashan really didn’t want this “little brother” to return home. He really liked to be together with this “little brother”.

sentences.simplified: 一路上，大山和小英都没有说话。
sentences.traditional: 一路上，大山和小英都沒有說話。
sentences.pinyin: yí lù shang dà shān hé xiǎo yīng dōu méi yǒu shuō huà
sentences.english: The whole journey, both Dashan and Xiao Ying didn’t say anything.

raw.synopsis: This is our elementary level adaptation of the classic Chinese legend “Butterfly Lovers”.
sentence_translations: Xiao Ying thought: After I return home, I won’t be able to see Dashan anymore.
I like Dashan, I want to be his wife, I want to be together with him every day.
I have to tell Dashan I like him.
But, I’m a girl, how do I say “I like you”?
At that time, all girls did what their Father and Mother said.
Father and Mother said whose wife they wanted them to be, and they would have to be that someone’s wife.
Regardless if they liked it or not, they would have to do whatever Father and Mother said.
Therefore, at that time, girls couldn’t say things like “I like you” to boys.
Then what should Xiao Ying do?
If she went and said “I like you” to Dashan, she would feel very embarrassed.
But if she didn’t say it, Dashan wouldn’t know that she was a girl, and also wouldn't like her.
What to do? Xiao Ying thought up a good way to do it.
Xiao Ying found Qian Hong, and said to her:
“Aunt Qian, I have to return home. I want to ask you to help me with something.”
“Ok, say it!” Qian Hong said.
These three years, if Xiao Ying had something on her mind, she would always go look for Qian Hong to talk.
Because in this school, it was only Qian Hong that knew that she was a girl.
Xiao Ying could only look to Qian Hong to talk about girl worries.
Qian Hong also really liked to listen to Xiao Ying talk about her worries.
She really liked Xiao Ying and thought that Xiao Ying was just like her own daughter.
“I want to ask you to help me tell Dashan that I like him.” Xiao Ying said a long time after she sat down.
Qian Hong smiled and said:
“Ok! I will tell him you’re a girl, you like him, and you want to be his wife. Do you think it would work this way?”
“Thank you Aunt Qian!” Xiao Ying happily jumped up.
Qian Hong said smilingly: “Don’t mention it!”
The next day, Xiao Ying had to return home. Dashan and Xiao Ying walked out of the school.
Dashan really didn’t want this “little brother” to return home. He really liked to be together with this “little brother”.
The whole journey, both Dashan and Xiao Ying didn’t say anything.
